description: Quectel EP06-E / EP06-A / EG06 on USB 2c7c:0306 (LTE Cat 6). Ports by interface: 0 DIAG, 1 GNSS, 2 primary AT, 3 secondary AT/PPP; QMI data function follows, when qmi_wwan is loaded. EP06-E has no GSM radio; legacy QCFG nwscanmode (0 auto, 2 WCDMA, 3 LTE) and QCFG band masks (firmware-dependent); do not use 5G-generation QNWPREFCFG. Never alter QCFG usbnet automatically. On EP06-E/EG06-E raw AT+CUSD was reported to acknowledge without a network reply; MM USSD/firmware variants require separate live verification. Field confirmation 2026-11-19: firmware EP06ELAR04A06M4G on OpenWrt 25.12.6 (qmi_wwan 2-1:1.4, /dev/cdc-wdm1, wwan1; ttyUSB5 AT/PPP, ttyUSB6 AT). ModemManager is connected with backend auto; native handover remains unverified.

hints.at_source: ModemManager port-type rules for 2c7c:0306, Linux qmi_wwan matching, validated EP06-E live composition: AT on interface 2 and optionally 3; map by USB interface, not changing ttyUSB index; field report 2026-11-19 confirms ttyUSB5 for USB interface 02 and ttyUSB6 for 03 (MM selected ttyUSB6 as preferred AT), with role distinctions not stable tty indexes
hints.ussd_source: EP06-E/EG06-E raw AT+CUSD acknowledgement without useful network reply; do not treat command OK as network delivery

sms.owner: modemmanager first when MM owns the modem; native only under a leased AT port
sms.send: PDU/UCS2 for Cyrillic and multipart; wait for CMGS prompt and +CMGS confirmation; ambiguous timeouts must not blindly resend
sms.storage: Avoid AT CPMS access during MM probe; distinguish SM/ME/MT, archive before purging, handle segmented messages

cell_lock.write_policy: Read both common/4g and common/lte on engine-owned AT. Only permit an explicitly selected EARFCN+PCI after a valid, fully parsed QNWLOCK reply with captured rollback. /4g count/tuples and /lte action/status must be distinguished; preserve multi-cell history. Under ModemManager/QModem ownership no direct AT.
cell_lock.persistence: common/lte not saved; common/4g persistence firmware-dependent; never change save_ctrl automatically

telemetry.serving: AT+QENG="servingcell": LTE PCI EARFCN TAC RSRP RSRQ RSSI SINR, LTE bandwidth is an index (0=1.4,1=3,2=5,3=10,4=15,5=20 MHz); SINR is already dB, do not rescale.
telemetry.ca: AT+QCAINFO: LTE PCC/SCC EARFCN band bandwidth PCI signal; SCC state 1=deactivated (listed, not aggregated now), 2=activated. OK without PCC is no confirmed CA, not proof of absent LTE-A capability.
telemetry.neighbours: AT+QENG="neighbourcell": LTE intra EARFCN PCI RSRQ RSRP RSSI (RSRQ before RSRP); drop invalid/truncated rows and avoid offering serving PCI/EARFCN as a neighbour lock target.
telemetry.antenna: AT+QRSRP: PRX DRX RX2 RX3 (optionally RAT fifth field); EP06 has two physical Rx chains, ignore -140/-32768 and unused RX2/RX3; neither weak readings nor RXDIV identify a disconnected antenna.
telemetry.temperature: AT+QTEMP: 3/4 signed sensor values; native engine-owned AT reads this beside QCAINFO and displays the maximum in modem_c. Reject 255/-140/-32768 and nonnumeric or out-of-range readings; never access the MM-owned port.
telemetry.operator: AT+QSPN: prefer SPN with nonnumeric fallback; network operator and SIM operator remain distinct

native_qmi.auto_selection: ModemManager first; native QMI explicit-only, QModem explicit-only on EP06-E. Do not inherit generic Quectel QModem-first policy.
native_qmi.ownership: exclusive: release ModemManager before uqmi; never run direct QMI concurrently with MM
native_qmi.fallback: restore previous ModemManager interface if bring-up fails

sim_slots.read: QMI UIM slot-status through the exclusive QMI owner
sim_slots.policy: Do not assume AT+QUIMSLOT? on EP06-E: observed ERROR/no reply; verify the exact firmware and active slot before exposing a switch.

field_validation.usb: 2c7c:0306; interface 0 option ttyUSB3 unknown, 1 ttyUSB4 GNSS, 2 ttyUSB5 AT/PPP, 3 ttyUSB6 AT, 4 qmi_wwan cdc-wdm1/wwan1
field_validation.identity: exact Quectel EP06-E profile match; ModemManager quectel plugin, /org/freedesktop/ModemManager1/Modem/3 at capture
field_validation.management: MM owns control, session, AT; connected via netifd proto modemmanager mm5, wwan1; backend option still auto despite attempted native selection on r8
field_validation.connectivity: MTS RUS LTE: RSRP -82 dBm, RSRQ -12 dB, SINR 3.4 dB; standby-ready measured reachability; no native QMI session confirmed
field_validation.logs: 09:08:40 operator freeze inhibits MM and drops mm5; 09:08:42 operator unfreeze restores MM ports; 09:08:59 MM connected again; short freeze/unfreeze is not proof of successful owner handover
field_validation.caveats: One previous qmi_wwan driver bind caused session disruption and MM object churn, but no current instability. ModemManager may use ttyUSB5 for PPP even when qmi_wwan exists; native QMI must use a correctly validated cdc-wdm/netdev pair and exclusive port ownership.
field_validation.native_acceptance: NOT TESTED; no active native QMI, AT QNWLOCK readback, or cell lock proof from this report

radio.source: EP06-E hardware-specific QCFG/QENG/QCAINFO/QNWLOCK/QRSRP/QTEMP observations; per-firmware feature detection mandatory; docs/modem-zoo/modems/quectel-lte-ec25-ep06-em12.md
